attempts.sql: WITH RECURSIVE base AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'src/click/exceptions.py' AND name = 'ClickException' AND kind = 'class'), chain AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id AS symbol_id, 1 AS inheritance_depth FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN base b ON cb.base_symbol_id = b.symbol_id UNION ALL SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, c.inheritance_depth + 1 FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN chain c ON cb.base_symbol_id = c.symbol_id) SELECT s.symbol_id, MIN(c.inheritance_depth) AS inheritance_depth FROM chain c JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.symbol_id WHERE s.file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' GROUP BY s.symbol_id ORDER BY inheritance_depth, s.symbol_id
